# Empty instructions in constructor allocation arguments

Owned Java specifies one fresh six-argument Value followed by delegation to
Core's primary constructor. Independently authored smali expresses the same
operations, with exact empty nop instructions before or between its reference
copies. It is not claimed to be compiler-generated bytecode. All argument
identities, the initialized allocation and the original receiver remain distinct.

The frozen observer covers nulls, aliases, argument order, constructor effects,
partially initialized fields, checked and unchecked failures, and array mutation
inside callbacks. Ten wrong programs must fail before NeverD. Every original
input identity, complete compiler metadata and Exceptions are compared and every
emitted Java unit is compiled. Only the required Java 25 class-file version and
reported throw helper may differ. Provider bytecode and observers remain frozen.
